title: Aureline M5 clean-room rebuild lane
description: Canonical per-domain clean-room rebuild lane for the M5 build lanes. Names the rebuild source class (hermetic clean-room rebuild, rematerialized input replay, pinned-digest replay, shared-cache shortcut, or unreplayable reference), the rebuild-config digest, the replay receipt, the protected-input ledger, the rebuild authority the lane is bounded to, the artifact families it expects, the hermetic-rebuild posture, and the shared-cache isolation rule, so a clean-room rebuild replays protected inputs without ever relying on shared remote-cache state as authority, the rebuild-config-digest / replay-receipt / rebuild-authority boundary stays visible before promotion, and non-hermetic inputs, cache poisoning, and unreplayable artifacts block promotion. Downstream release-center, shiproom, diagnostics, provenance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's rebuild posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
